SNN-Drone-s energy efficiency 7.7x higher than YOLOv8s; better detection than baseline ANNs and YOLOv8 variants
SNNLoc WiFi localization: comparable or better accuracy with over 90% lower energy (hardware simulator comparison across architectures)
PTQ for SNNs: 2-bit weights, at most 8 time steps on CIFAR-10/100, ImageNet-1K; test-time neuron pruning cuts time steps
SNNSIR stereo restoration: comparable to advanced ANN methods on Stereo Waterdrop with about two orders of magnitude less energy
SNN training accelerator: 2.22-2.30x Spikformer training speedup and 29% EDP reduction vs backpropagation; no ANN comparison
SparrowSNN hybrid ANN-SNN ASIC: 20x to 100x lower energy than existing ultra-low power solutions (types unstated); no ANN baseline named
QUDA CSR systolic dataflow for neuromorphic SNNs: better resource use and power than SOTA designs; no network-level ANN evaluation
SCAE-SNN HAR: F1 near 96% comparable to hybrid approach, 81.1% spike sparsity; no ANN comparison
Spike-based diffractive optical network S2NN: 2036 FPS single-layer inference, 20x faster than frame-based DONN (reported results)
FPGA SNN accelerator for modulation classification: 23.5 MS/s (about 2x baseline), dynamic power -58.7%; baseline type unstated, no ANN comparison
Spiking RNN with sparse gradient descent for NLP (IMDB, AG NEWS): competitive accuracy vs ANNs; no efficiency figures
S3DNet spiking point cloud: ModelNet40 92.34%, ScanObjectNN 84.49%, 1.18M params; low energy claimed, no ANN comparison
STASNN EEG seizure detection claims significantly reduced theoretical energy with high accuracy; no figures
Hybrid conv-LIF radar HAR: 88% fewer parameters, under 1% accuracy loss; latency, memory, energy vs three ANNs (no figures)
Fully spiking swin flow network vs same-backbone ANN STTFlowNet on DSEC and MVSEC: competitive accuracy, favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off (no figures)
SPEAR 24.3-135.3x speedup, 154.4-845.3x energy efficiency over GPU; 4.9x vs point cloud accelerators, 2.4x vs spiking transformer accelerators
Sparse MFCC encoding: fewer spikes, same accuracy; fMRISNN less accurate but more energy efficient than deep CNN (literature)
Evolutionary pathway pruning (ABC-Arc) plus dynamic PTQ for SpikeLM on GLUE; performance kept, model size and power reduced (no figures)
LIF-STDP IAQ sensing: 8.9x (about 89%) fewer FLOPs than LSTM inference; sparse firing ratio 10.94%; hardware validation still needed
Spike-EVPR event-based place recognition: Recall@1 +7.61% (Brisbane-Event-VPR) and +13.20% (DDD20); energy reduced significantly (no figures)
Spike-driven Conv-Transformer on DEAP and MAHNOB-HCI: SOTA arousal accuracy, average 16x less energy than ANN-based methods
SPiKe-Med hybrid spiking CNN-transformer MRI segmentation; evaluates Dice, spike rate and estimated energy per inference; no results given in abstract
